report_name: Krybit Ransomware Group Claims Attack on Singaporean Healthcare Firm

threat_actors.name: Krybit
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that conducted a double-extortion attack against a healthcare company in Singapore, encrypting systems and exfiltrating data for financial leverage. The group's initial access vector is believed to be the exploitation of vulnerable web applications.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Attackers encrypted files on the victim's network, rendering systems unusable as part of a double-extortion strategy.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The attack is reported to have originated through the company's web applications, suggesting the exploitation of a vulnerability for initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Transfer Data to Cloud Account
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exfiltrated large volumes of sensitive data, such as patient records and financial information, to attacker-controlled cloud storage before deploying the ransomware.

attack_patterns.name: Web Shell
attack_patterns.description: A web shell was likely deployed after initial access via web application exploitation to establish persistence and map the internal network.

malware.name: Krybit Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the Krybit group to encrypt victim systems and exfiltrate data as part of a double-extortion campaign.

identities.name: Singaporean Healthcare Company
identities.description: An unnamed healthcare company in Singapore targeted by the Krybit ransomware group in a double-extortion attack.

infrastructure.name: Attacker-controlled cloud storage
infrastructure.description: Cloud storage infrastructure used by the Krybit group to store data exfiltrated from the victim network.

indicators.name: Web Server Process Spawning Shell
indicators.pattern:
title: Web Server Process Spawning Shell
id: 9c5b1a3e-7d8f-4b1a-9c8d-6f5e4d3c2b1a
status: experimental
description: Detects a web server process (e.g., w3wp.exe for IIS) spawning a command-line shell, which could indicate web shell execution or exploitation following a compromise.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-21-aug-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-22
tags:
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web server processes spawning command shells, a common indicator of web shell deployment after initial access, as mentioned in the Krybit attack analysis.
